title: Nut-Free Friendly Smoked Filipino Turkey Pastry
description: A unique Filipino-inspired pastry dish featuring smoked turkey neck, wrapped in a flaky and crispy pastry crust, perfect for a date-night dinner.
instructions: In a pan over medium heat, sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the smoked turkey neck to the pan and cook until browned on all sides.
In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
Place the turkey neck in the center of the pastry rectangle, leaving a 1-inch border around it.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg.
Roll the pastry over the turkey neck, starting with one of the long edges.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the top of the pastry with the remaining beaten egg.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pastry in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
